final_events.transcript: Good morning. How are you feeling today?
I'm not feeling well, Doctor. I've had a headache and fever since yesterday. I see.
Do you also have a sore throat or cough?
Yes. I've been coughing a little and my throat feels dry. All right.
It's slightly high. Have you taken any medicine yet? Just some Tylenol, but it didn't help much. Okay. It looks like a mild infection.
